messages:
Ana (Partnerships): Quick update — GreenGrid Energy finished their edge rollout using our Private runtime on substations and just signed a 24-month agreement for Dedicated + on-prem edge seats. Big cross-team win :tada:

Elaine (Solutions): Hell yes! Any highlights we can surface for the partner spotlight?

Ana (Partnerships): They reported a 3x inference cost reduction after we switched them to our quantized runtime and enabled prefix caching. Want to do a short case study + partner quote.

Marco (Eng Runtime): Helped tune their LLM shard placement and KV cache TTLs. Diff against baseline: latency stable, token cost down ~65%. Happy to contribute a short tech blurb. Code snippet we used: `RL_INFER_MODE=private cache_ttl=600 quant=8bit`

Samir (Sales): Officially closed — ARR +$420k annualized. Deal desk signed yesterday. Will add to Q2 scoreboard.

Leah (Marketing): Great — I'll draft the partner spotlight blog and a 1-pager. Can someone share a customer quote or exec line?

Ana (Partnerships): I'll ask the GreenGrid PM for a short quote. Tagging @Pat for legal sign-off on quoting: @Pat can you confirm consent flow?

Pat (Legal): On it. Please send the proposed quote and the customer's contact for recording. We usually need a one-paragraph approval + logo grant. ETA EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Case-study draft created in Google Drive: https://docs.google.com/example/greengrid-case-study (access: partnerships + marketing) :white_check_mark:

Elaine (Solutions): I put a 2-paragraph tech appendix in that doc with diagrams.

Marco (Eng Runtime): Also adding perf charts (before/after) to the doc.

Samir (Sales): Heads-up to AE team — renewal cadence set to Q1 2028, upsell trigger in 12 months for additional edge sites.

Leah (Marketing): I'll plan a short webinar with GreenGrid ops in 3 weeks. Need a speaker from Eng Runtime and Partnerships.

Ana (Partnerships): Thanks all — big kudos to Eng Runtime, Solutions, Sales, and Legal for the fast turnaround. Posting a short shoutout in #general after Pat confirms quoting. :clap:
